verdict.rationale: Apify offers proxy rotation to avoid blocking and browser automation tooling (Playwright/Puppeteer/Crawlee) that can be used to build anti-bot workflows, and its MCP server lets agents discover/run these Actors autonomously. However, there is no explicit evidence of automated CAPTCHA-solving, login-wall bypass, or form-wall traversal without manual setup/intervention—these would require custom Actor development rather than being an out-of-the-box agent capability.
